spin_360.notes: Product page embeds an 'Interactive view' (via experience-loader-bose.vercel.app) pointing to Bose's 360 viewer at 360-viewer.bose.com?product=qcuhp2. The viewer is a Three.js/react-three-fiber WebGL app loading .glb 3D models with HDR environment lighting (bundle references qcuhp assets, shadow .glb files, .hdr maps) - CGI 3D model, not photographic frames.

collection_gaps: 1st-gen (2023) QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (QCUH-HEADPHONEARN) not collected; its owner's guide exists at https://assets.bose.com/content/dam/Bose_DAM/Web/consumer_electronics/global/products/headphones/QCUH-HEADPHONEARN/pdf/884885_OG_QCUH-HEADPHONEARN_en.pdf and support page at https://support.bose.com/s/product/bose-quietcomfort-ultra-headphones/01t8c00000QEpaxAAD.
No separate quick-start-guide PDF is published for the 2nd gen; the in-box 'Power User Gestures' carton insert PDF was collected as the closest equivalent.
Bluetooth codec list beyond aptX Adaptive (Snapdragon Sound) is not explicitly enumerated on official pages checked; SBC/AAC support not officially confirmed in collected sources.
Bose does not publish minimum iOS/Android versions for the Bose app on the support article checked.
No official macro close-up of earcup controls in the product gallery; Gallery 5 (top-front view with aux cable) is the closest official shot.

assets.bose.com presented an expired TLS certificate (CN www.bose.com, expired 2026-06-05) on 2026-08-20; equivalent official files were retrieved from assets.bosecreative.com as linked by the official support page.

Third support video ('Changes to Voice Prompts & Device Switching') has an unresolvable CMS-style videoId in its embed; player URL recorded as embedded but title/duration could not be verified via the Brightcove API.
Only the Gallery 1 hero image was collected for non-Black colorways; full 8-image galleries exist per colorway on the product page if needed later.

curation_log.reason: The curated video index was collected with the other four products and is referenced by the Bose support-page source notes, but its local copy was omitted from the Bose manifest. Registering the existing file resolves the orphan without changing its contents.
